english.title: Sex offender fail to notify name / address to police on initial registration
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), failed without reasonable excuse to comply with section 2(1) of the Sex Offenders Act 1997 in that you did not, within 3 days of **(..SPECIFY RELEVANT DATE..), notify the police of

(A)_[your name]_
(B)_[each of the names used by you, namely **(..SPECIFY NAMES..)]_
(C)_[your home address]_
(D)_[your date of birth]_
(E)_[**(..SPECIFY WHERE MORE THAN ONE OF THE ABOVE OPTIONS APPLY..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 3(1)(a) and (1A) of the Sex Offenders Act 1997.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
THIS OFFENCE IS NOW OBSOLETE - now see offence wording CJS Code SX03204 - H5862 or CJS Code SX03205 -H5863

(i) It is suggested that the six months time limit period for prosecution commences on the day the offence is discovered - NOT the day the offence starts.
(ii) The offence starts on the first day of failure to comply and continues throughout any period of failure.
(iii) Offender will only be prosecuted once for the same failure (section 3(2)).
(iv) See Section 2(7) for meaning of "home address" and Section 1(8) for "relevant date"
(v) As amended by Schedule 5 to the Criminal Justice and Court Services Act 2000
(vi) Repealed by s.140 of and Schedule 7 to the Sexual Offences Act 2003

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.

Where the offender is under the age of eighteen years
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale. (section 4(4)).

INDICTMENT: Five years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
